name: Grant
description: Profile for documenting research funding grants with funder information (ROR or DOI), grant codes, and project details.
ExpectedUse: Documentation of funding sources, grant tracking, compliance with funder requirements, and research impact assessment.

Properties.Name: funderRorId
Properties.Title: Funder ROR ID
Properties.Description: ROR identifier URL for the funding organization.

Properties.Name: funderName
Properties.Title: Funder Name
Properties.Description: Human-readable name of the funding organization.

Properties.Name: grantCode
Properties.Title: Grant Code
Properties.Description: Grant award number or identifier assigned by the funding organization.

Properties.Name: projectName
Properties.Title: Project Name
Properties.Description: Official title of the funded research project.

Properties.Name: projectWebsite
Properties.Title: Project Website
Properties.Description: URL to the project's official website or landing page.

Properties.Name: funds
Properties.Title: Funds
Properties.Description: Handle identifiers of FDOs (datasets, experiments, materials) funded by this grant.
